kairos.name: browser_navigate
kairos.description: Open a URL in the current tab (launches the browser if needed), or pass back / forward / reload. Returns the page snapshot with [ref=eN] handles (for a large page: its top and an outline; search the rest with browser_search_page).

url.description: Absolute URL, or back | forward | reload

kairos.name: browser_snapshot
kairos.description: Full accessibility snapshot of the current page with [ref=eN] handles. Actions already return page state; use this to see the whole page again, or pass target to read one section.

target.description: Ref of one element to snapshot (e.g. a table or form)

depth.description: Limit the snapshot to this many levels

kairos.name: browser_click
kairos.description: Click an element by ref. Pass x/y instead of ref to click viewport coordinates (canvas, captchas, elements missing from the snapshot).

ref.description: Ref from the latest snapshot, e.g. e12 or f1e12

kairos.name: browser_type
kairos.description: Replace the content of a text field by typing like a human. submit presses Enter afterwards.

kairos.name: browser_fill_form
kairos.description: Fill several fields in one call. checkbox/radio take "true" or "false"; combobox takes an option label or value.

kairos.name: browser_select
kairos.description: Select option(s) in a <select> by label or value.

kairos.name: browser_hover
kairos.description: Move the mouse over an element (menus, tooltips).

kairos.name: browser_drag
kairos.description: Drag one element onto another (from_ref, to_ref), or between viewport coordinates (x1, y1, x2, y2).

kairos.name: browser_press_key
kairos.description: Press a key or combination on the focused element, e.g. Enter, Escape, Tab, Control+A.

kairos.name: browser_scroll
kairos.description: Scroll by viewport heights. With ref, scroll the area under that element (inner scroll panes).

kairos.name: browser_wait_for
kairos.description: Wait for text to appear, text to disappear, or a number of seconds (max 60).

timeout.description: Seconds to wait for text, default 30

kairos.name: browser_screenshot
kairos.description: Screenshot of the viewport, the full page, or one element (ref), returned as an image. For visual checks; prefer snapshots for reading and acting.

kairos.name: browser_evaluate
kairos.description: Run JavaScript in the page and return the JSON result: an expression (document.title) or a function (() => ...). With ref, pass a function that receives the element (el => el.value).

kairos.name: browser_search_page
kairos.description: Search the whole page's snapshot for text (or a regex) and return every match with its ref, nearby lines and parent elements, plus the total count.

kairos.name: browser_tabs
kairos.description: List, open, select or close tabs. index is 0-based; close without index closes the current tab.

kairos.name: browser_handle_dialog
kairos.description: Accept or dismiss the open alert/confirm/prompt dialog.

kairos.name: browser_console
kairos.description: Console messages and uncaught errors of the current page (since it loaded). Without index: a list. With index: one message in full.

kairos.name: browser_network
kairos.description: Network requests for the current tab. Without index: a list (filter = URL substring). With index: one request with headers.

kairos.name: browser_profile
kairos.description: Persistent profiles keep logins, cookies and a fixed fingerprint, shared with Claude Code's cloakbrowser MCP (one browser per profile at a time). list shows them; use relaunches the browser in a profile (created if new); ephemeral relaunches with a throwaway session. proxy applies to the relaunch.

kairos.name: browser_close
kairos.description: Close the browser. The next browser tool relaunches it.
